description:
Fever at the drop of a hat, joint pain so severe it makes holding chopsticks difficult, heart palpitations that make daily life hard, overwhelming depression, severe insomnia...

Early menopause arriving at the young age of thirty. Experiencing a full spectrum of menopausal symptoms earlier than most, the protagonist gradually realizes these symptoms are simply one manifestation of aging that eventually comes to everyone. Just as the records of the Imjin War during the Joseon Dynasty's Seonjo era were preserved in the ‘Jingbirok’ (Record of Admonition), she aims to create Menopause Chronicles to share wisdom and warn against future troubles, preserving this knowledge as a webtoon.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
